How to fit

Lay panels flat for 24 hours before and ensure the wall is clean and dry.
Fit corner trimsusing solvent-free adhesive.
Cut panels with a handsaw or jigsaw, allowing 15mm clearance for corner trims. Also leave a 2-3mm expansion gap around pipes and fittings.
Apply adhesive to the back of each panel and press firmly removing air pockets.
Seal all trims and joints with waterproof silicone.

A must-have for gardeners, pond keepers, and DIY enthusiasts, this plug provides practical reliability for a variety of water flow management needs.

product.name: i-warm flux underfloor heating kit 8m2
product.description:
The i-warm flux underfloor heating system is a retrofit-friendly solution, designed for LVT & SPC flooring, engineered wood (dry-lay), and heat-resistant carpet. As a result, it brings comfort and energy efficiency to modern homes. Using ultra-thin graphene infrared technology, it ensures fast, even heat distribution, making it ideal for living spaces. Pack Sizes: Available in 2m², 4m², 6m², and 8m² packs, with custom lengths available. This flexibility allows installation in rooms of any size or shape.

Versatile Flooring Compatibility: Works with LVT, SPC click flooring, engineered wood (dry-lay), and heat-resistant carpets. However, always check flooring or carpet specifications before installation.

Easy Retrofit Installation: Fitted over existing floors, it requires a vapour membrane (PET) and silver-backed acoustic underlay (3mm or 6mm). Therefore, it’s a perfect choice for renovations.

Efficient Heating: Producing 220W per m² of infrared heat, flux ensures consistent warmth, eliminating cold spots for enhanced comfort.

Smart Integration: Compatible with i-warm Thermostats & Salus Smart Thermostats, which allows remote control via smart app control, optimising energy use. Even Heat Distribution: Provides a more uniform spread than traditional radiators, ensuring a pleasant room temperature.

Invisible Heating: Hidden beneath flooring, it maintains a clean, clutter-free aesthetic while delivering powerful warmth.

Comfort & Convenience: Radiant heating adds luxury to kitchens, living rooms, and other spaces, making daily routines more comfortable.

product.name: i-warm core underfloor heating kit 2LM
product.description:
The i-warm core is designed to be installed under screed application, a professional-grade underfloor heating product. Ideal for early build projects, core utilises encapsulated PET technology combined with graphene infrared heating, making it suitable for demanding environments and durable flooring options. Pre-Wired Lengths: Available in 1LM, 2LM, 3LM, and 4LM, i-warm core offers a simple installation, ideal for construction professionals and large projects. 
Built for Tough Environments: Strong materials make it suitable for commercial spaces and high-traffic homes.

Long-Lasting Performance: Reliable components reduce maintenance needs, ensuring years of consistent heating.

Even Heat Distribution: Embedded within flooring, it provides stable, all-over warmth, making rooms comfortable year-round.

Durable Construction: Encapsulated PET technology makes it resistant to moisture, ensuring long-term reliability in kitchens, bathrooms, and damp areas.

Early Build Installation: Embedded in screed, it works well with porcelain tiles, stone, and other heavy flooring materials.

Energy Efficiency: Graphene infrared technology provides strong heating while keeping energy use low. Therefore, it helps maintain a comfortable indoor temperature.

Smart Control Compatibility: Compatible with i-warm Thermostats & Salus Smart Thermostats, which allows remote control via smart app control, optimising energy use.

This sleek, space-saving ensemble provides a contemporary solution for any modern home, effortlessly combining style with practicality. Featuring a pristine high-gloss white finish, this set includes a compact 420mm single-door vanity unit with an integrated ceramic basin and deep internal shelving, alongside a matching 500mm WC unit. The D-shaped rimless back-to-wall toilet, complete with a soft-close wrap-over seat, ensures superior hygiene and easy cleaning. To complete your installation, the set comes fully equipped with a side-entry concealed cistern (featuring a WRAS-approved internal valve), a stylish polished chrome square push button, a contemporary square waterfall chrome basin tap, and a matching chrome waste. Enjoy a cohesive, high-quality bathroom upgrade designed for convenience and a refined aesthetic.

product.name: Aveli Bathroom Round Shower Kit 1 Spray Adjustable Handset Riser Rail Black
product.description:
Enhance your bathroom with the Affine Round Black Shower Riser Kit - a sleek and versatile addition designed for modern living. With its bold black finish and contemporary round handset, this riser kit instantly elevates the style of your shower space.

The adjustable riser rail allows you to set the height of the shower head for comfort and convenience, making it suitable for all users. The round handset features multiple spray patterns, offering a customisable and enjoyable showering experience tailored to your preferences.

A 1500mm flexible shower hose is included to provide excellent reach and manoeuvrability, ideal for both everyday use and cleaning tasks. Compatible with most standard shower systems, this riser kit is a practical solution for upgrading your bathroom with a designer edge.

Built for durability and ease of use, it also comes with a 1 year manufacturer guarantee for added peace of mind.

Key Features:
Stylish black finish for a modern, high-end look
Adjustable riser rail for personalised height adjustment
Round handset with multiple spray patterns for tailored comfort
1500mm shower hose for improved flexibility and range
Simple installation with universal compatibility
1 year manufacturer guarantee

product.name: Round Multi Spray Adjustable Hand Shower Kit Black Riser Rail Bathroom System
product.description: Stylish black finish shower kit designed to add a modern touch to any bathroom. Features an adjustable handset on a sliding riser rail for flexible height positioning and everyday comfort. The round multi-spray handset offers different spray settings for a personalized shower experience. Includes a 1500mm flexible hose for extended reach and easy movement. Built with durable materials for long-lasting performance and reliable daily use. Simple to install with standard fittings, making it a practical upgrade for any bathroom space.

product.name: Lux Heat Oval Horizontal Coloured Radiator - Metallic Copper - 600mm x 1140mm - Double Panel
product.description: Make a bold statement with the Lux Heat Oval Horizontal Coloured Radiator in metallic copper. This double panel mild steel radiator measures 600mm x 1140mm, delivers up to 4926 BTU (1444 W) at ΔT50°C for rooms up to 18 m², and is designed for central heating systems. Supplied with wall fixings, brackets, a bleed valve and a blanking plug, it is wall-mounted and backed by a 5-year warranty, with a made-to-order lead time of 7-14 working days.

product.name: Lux Heat Oval Horizontal Double Panel Radiator Metallic Copper 400mm x 780mm - 5 Year Warranty
product.description: Add a bold splash of metallic copper and efficient central heating with this Lux Heat double panel oval horizontal radiator. Supplied with wall fixings, brackets, bleed valve and blanking plug, it mounts horizontally with 870 mm pipe centres and projects 85 mm from the wall. Backed by a 5-year warranty for long-term peace of mind.

product.name: Nes Home Square Shower Matte Black Handset and Hose with Slider Riser Rail Bracket
product.description: Our matt black square slider rail kits are a modern and affordable showering option for any bathroom. This stunning shower kit will give your bathroom a beautiful new and stylish look.

product.name: Garland Budget Propagator with Drainage Holes - Small, 23cm Seed Tray for Windowsills
product.description:
Get your seeds off to a strong start with the Garland Small Budget Propagator, a practical and affordable solution for home seed germination. Designed to create a warm and sheltered environment, this compact propagator helps encourage faster germination and healthier early growth for flowers, herbs, vegetables and other young plants.

The sturdy injection-moulded base tray is made from 100% recycled plastic and features two-tier drainage holes that support effective base watering while helping to prevent waterlogging. Maintaining the correct moisture level is essential for successful germination, and the drainage system helps protect delicate seedlings from excess water during their early stages of growth.

A lightweight clear vacuum-formed lid helps retain warmth and humidity around your seeds, creating a consistent environment that encourages quicker germination and stronger development. The transparent cover also allows plenty of natural light to reach your seedlings while making it easy to monitor progress without disturbing the growing conditions.

Manufactured in the UK, this compact propagator is ideal for windowsills, conservatories, greenhouses and other small growing spaces. Measuring 23cm long, 17cm wide and 12.5cm high, it is perfectly sized for raising a variety of seedlings while taking up minimal space.

Whether you are starting a vegetable garden, growing herbs indoors or raising bedding plants for the season ahead, the Garland Small Budget Propagator offers a simple, reliable and environmentally conscious way to achieve better germination results.

product.name: Crikey Mikey Sink & Drain Unblocker, Sink Bomb Fast-Acting, 500g
product.description:
When a plug hole is blocked and the water won't drain, Crikey Mikey Sink Bomb is a fast-acting formula that helps dissolve blockages in kitchen, bathroom and shower plug holes without needing a plumber. It removes the nasty smells blockages cause and kills the germs breeding within them.

It cuts through grease, descales, dissolves hair, and cuts through soap and general organic sink waste — a genuinely versatile unblocker for the everyday causes of a slow or blocked drain, saving the cost and hassle of a call-out.

product.name: Water Butt Diverter Kit Downpipe Waterbutt Filler Kit Fits Both Round & Square Downpipes - Connect Downpipe to Water Butt
product.description:
Rainwater Butt Diverter Set for waterbutts
Diverters are additional fittings that can be attached to your home downpipe to provide a direct connection to your water butt.

Designed to collect some rainwater diverting the rainwater into your waterbutt. The diverter connector kit uses a tube straight into your water butt with the ability to control any overflow when your water butt is full.

Waterbutt Connector Fixing Kit: Allows easy collection of rainwater from your downpipe. Prevents the water butt from over filling when it is full. Connects downpipe to the rain barrel.

Perfect for your garden or allotment allowing water to be easily accessed when needed.

This waterbutt hose kit set includes; 1x rain diverter, 1x hose connector, 1x flexible hose pipe, 1x washer and 1x fixing nut.

Divert rain from your downpipe to your rain barrel fits the majority of downpipes used in the home, including square and round types. Once the water butt is full (if properly fitted) the water butt will not overflow but the water will continue to flow down the downpipe.

FEATURES
Downpipe Rainwater Diversion Kit.
Suitable for both round and square downpipes
Made of sturdy black plastic
Easy to install
Great water saver
Made in the UK

Using a rainwater diverter is a great way to save on costs and time on refilling, reduce your impact on the environment and maintain a supply of free and readily available water for use around the home and garden.

PERFECT FOR FITTING A WATERBUTT TO:
Small garages, Greenhouses / Garden buildings, Sheds & Summerhouses and will fit either 68mm square or 65mm round PVC Downpipe Rainwater Pipes

product.name: Hoses UK 25mm Clear PVC Corrugated Flexible Water Butt Hose 1m Reinforced Downpipe Connector Rainwater Harvesting Pump Pond
product.description: The Hoses UK Clear PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is a lightweight, UV-resistant and flexible hose designed for water transfer, pond circulation, and general fluid handling. Its transparent design allows easy monitoring of water or fluid movement, making it ideal for applications that benefit from visual inspection. Manufactured with a smooth PVC inner wall and a corrugated PVC outer layer, the hose incorporates a high-tensile plastic rib reinforcement to provide durability and crush resistance while maintaining flexibility. The transparent construction allows operators to monitor flow and detect blockages or contamination quickly, which is particularly useful in pond systems, aquatics, and industrial water circulation. This hose is also widely used for workshop water transfer and light chemical solutions where visibility and flexible installation are essential. Available in a range of sizes with internal diameters from 19 mm to 50 mm and wall thicknesses from 2 mm to 4 mm, the Hoses UK Clear PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is suitable for a variety of applications including pond and aquarium circulation, garden water features, drainage systems, irrigation setups, and light industrial fluid handling tasks.

product.description:

product.description:
Infuse warmth into your home with our cutting-edge oval single column radiators in black and thermostatic chrome valve set - a perfect blend of timeless elegance and modern efficiency. 
Crafted with precision from premium 1.5mm carbon steel, these radiators are not only built to last but also designed to impress. Standing tall at 1800mm and spanning 360mm in width, they offer versatility in placement, fitting seamlessly into various spaces with ease. 
Boasting a sleek black finish, these radiators serve as a striking focal point, enhancing the ambiance of any room with their bold presence. Their appeal goes beyond aesthetics as they are meticulously engineered for optimal performance. Featuring single column with robust steel tubes measuring 60mm x 15mm, they deliver superior heat output, ensuring your space remains cosy and comfortable. 
The triple layered powder coating not only enhances durability but also provides resistance against wear, preserving the radiator's pristine appearance for years to come. And with the included cleaning brush, maintenance is a breeze, allowing you to effortlessly uphold its allure. 
Backed by CE approval, BS EN442 certification, and a generous 15-year guarantee, you can trust in the quality and reliability of our radiators. Plus, with all fixtures and fittings included, installation is hassle-free, promising a seamless integration into your existing décor. 
With standard 0.5" BSP inlet/outlet compatibility, you have the flexibility to choose valves that suit your preferences, ensuring a customised heating solution tailored to your needs. For added convenience, each radiator is supplied with a timeless chrome-finished thermostatic valve set, allowing for a quick and straightforward installation so you can enjoy efficient heating without delay. 
Elevate your surroundings with our classic style oval single column radiator in black!

Applications

K-RAD radiators are suitable for two pipe installations. For single pipe applications, it is advisable to use diversion tees in the pipework, as this will assist in obtaining design performance from the radiators.

Everything required for installation can be found within the robust packaging. Brackets are of a strong design, with open top and deep slots, which facilitates easy and secure installation. Plastic inserts seat the radiator precisely on the bracket minimizing expansion and contraction noise. product.name: FloPlast 135 Degree Solvent Weld Waste Bend 40mm White - Pack of 2
product.description: 135° solvent weld waste bends change direction in waste pipe runs and can be used in pairs to create offsets. Available in 32mm, 40mm and 50mm sizes, this listing is for the 40mm option supplied as a pack of two. Manufactured in the UK to BS EN 1455-1:2000 and kitemarked, the ABS fittings use solvent weld jointing. To fit, ensure pipe and fitting are clean and free of grit, apply SC250 solvent cement to both surfaces, push the pipe fully into the fitting and twist to ensure full contact. Wipe away excess solvent, allow 5 minutes to set and leave the installation for 12 hours before testing. Solvent weld joints are permanent. Work in a well ventilated area and avoid contact with skin; if contact occurs, wash thoroughly with soap and water.

product.name: Aluminium Hose Connector for Silicone Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes (40mm OD, 250mm Long)
product.description: This range of straight aluminium hose connectors provides a strong, lightweight, and corrosion-resistant solution for joining hoses in automotive, industrial, marine, and performance systems. Made from high-quality T6063 aluminium, each connector is engineered with a polished finish and consistent 1.6mm wall thickness, offering durability and a clean appearance. Available in a wide selection of outer diameters to suit standard hose sizes, these joiners are ideal for linking silicone, rubber, or plastic hoses in coolant systems, air intakes, vacuum lines, and oil or fuel setups. Whether you're building a custom engine bay or upgrading machinery, these connectors ensure a tight, efficient seal with minimal pressure drop. Easy to install, modify, or trim to length, they’re suitable for both professional workshops and home garages. Their compatibility with standard hoses makes them a versatile choice for long-lasting performance in harsh environments, withstanding extreme heat, vibration, and chemical exposure. A high-performance solution for anyone requiring precision connections in demanding systems.
